scientific_question: Did the 5TPP failure arise because the four shared trunks impose destructive late-horizon layer-gradient cancellation, and what is the smallest contiguous partition that removes it?

measurement.method: freeze all parameters, locally untie each layer c_fc/c_proj from its shared trunk, and measure exact task gradients

selection_rule.primary: choose the smallest group count for which both thresholds pass
selection_rule.tie_break: within that group count maximize minimum recovery, then mean recovery
selection_rule.failure: if no partition through eight trunks passes, reject cross-layer dense-trunk sharing rather than launching a training sweep
